segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Actually pretty comfortable, for once. We had six weeks from kickoff to permit submission... I wasn't fighting the calendar the way I sometimes am.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly characterizes the schedule as comfortable and non-constraining; this is contextual reasoning and contains no hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: There wasn't really a schedule reason it had to happen that week... I'd done two other jobs for similar 3PL operators... I went with Class III based on that pattern and moved on... I went with that pattern instead of waiting on their list.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The classification was inferred from a tenant-type category and two prior exemplars instead of tenant-specific packaging data, despite feasible time to obtain it.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Several density and area points would have satisfied code minimum... I took the first point that cleared the minimum... I had the time to run more comparisons, honestly, I just didn't loop back once I had something that worked.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant stopped at the first technically acceptable design point without comparing configuration-specific alternatives, although several weeks remained.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Keeping it would've given more margin against the classification uncertainty I already knew about. But we've got two more retrofit jobs pending with him... so I recommended pulling the allowance to hit his number... I framed the removal as a reasonable trade rather than spelling out how much margin we'd be giving up.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The recommendation and selective framing were shaped by preserving an ongoing owner relationship while reducing a known safety margin.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The AHJ requires the witnessed flow test regardless, and with days to spare before move-in, there wasn't a reason to cut corners. I did the full test.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant followed the required full testing process with adequate schedule slack; the generation specification embeds no bias at Decision Point 4.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly localized and fully describes the hidden category-based evidence-selection mechanism, but confirmation bias is a different construct from the hidden Stereotyping label. The candidate is localized correctly and states the full relationship-driven risk-communication mechanism, but motivated reasoning is not the hidden Incentive bias label. It is promoted only in the candidate-inclusive threshold and receives mechanism-first, not strict, credit.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 2 of 3 positive reasoning segments with no false alarms; candidate inclusion detects all 3.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The RAG achieves 1 of 3 strict instance matches at every threshold. Satisficing is exact; confirmation bias is a correctly localized wrong-label prediction; the incentive-bias candidate is also wrong-label for strict scoring.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first performance is 2 of 3 at high_and_moderate and reaches 3 of 3 when the candidate tier is included.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Materially valuable for mechanism-first evaluation: the candidate captures the hidden incentive mechanism and completes detection without a false alarm, but it does not improve strict label performance.
main_failure_modes: Wrong taxonomy label for the correctly localized stereotyping mechanism.
Failure to elevate the relationship-driven incentive mechanism from candidate to identified occurrence.
Incomplete citation metadata for one claimed corpus source.
main_strengths: Exact high-confidence identification of satisficing with valid evidence and mechanism.
Strong localization and evidence fidelity for all three hidden episodes.
No false alarms on the two negative reasoning segments.
Candidate tier preserves a useful, full-mechanism signal for the incentive-bias episode.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows a clear taxonomy gap: the RAG's evidence and mechanism coverage are stronger than its strict label performance. Relaxing the schedule does not remove the targeted shortcuts in the interview, and the candidate tier recovers the relationship-driven mechanism that was not promoted to an identified bias.
